progression.narrative: The performance opens on A2 and dwells most on A in Jamehdaran. The line peaks at B4 (500.4 Hz) at 0:17.5. It closes on Fs4, not the tonic (Gs4 → Gs4 → A4 → Gs4 → Fs4 → Fs4).
